title: <channel>/<build>/block_shapes.json.gz (decompressed): each block state's collision, visual and UI shapes, in the palette's order

blocks.description: Every block type in runtime id order (block_palette.nbt's), each with its states in the palette's order

collision.description: The boxes an entity collides with; none: it collides with nothing

visual.description: The box it is drawn in (getVisualShape)

ui.description: The box its outline is in the UI (getUIShape)

outline.description: The box a player's cursor outlines (getOutline)

camera.description: The box the camera collides with, null where it collides with none (getCollisionShapeForCamera); only from 1.20.30, which has it

box.description: [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ] in the block's own coordinates
